name: Collateral Parties 10
definition: Choice of format for the trading capacity.

PartyA.name: Party A
PartyA.definition: Instructing party sending the collateral instruction.

ClientPartyA.name: Client Party A
ClientPartyA.definition: Party that instructs party A to send the message.

ClientPartyB.name: Client Party B
ClientPartyB.definition: Party that instructs party B to settle the instruction on its behalf.

CollateralAccount.name: Collateral Account
CollateralAccount.definition: Account where the collateral is held during the lifecycle  of the transaction.
